author: stroodel
body:
Hey I'm stroodel, I usually play on OCN, I was in Kiube a team on OCN.  I had a team on avicus called God Squad, with MLGtino, Epsilpha and that stuff so now I've decided to look for a new team, I'm fast making cannons, I'm very good at bow and with sword, I can do fast bridge and ninja bridge and I'd like to play the tournament. My KD is bad because I usually rush for fun, I'm an OCN player so I don't play avicus a lot :P but I'll increase it.

My skype ( send me a message saying who are you and where are you from ): shenhdz11
